experiment.hypothesis: After a BTC-USD gap-down exceeding 2%, the price exhibits a 5-hour mean reversion with a probability greater than 60% when the 5-hour return remains below 2%.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.
